title: Angel's Share Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Old Seagrove beach house steps to beach, private pool, sleeps 10 comfortably, lots of beautiful indoor and outdoor space to enjoy your stay!
description_expanded: ✨Angels' Share has gotten a winter GLOW UP! All new furnishings, rugs, kitchen updates and more!✨ HOME HIGHLIGHTS: • Private, heated pool + outdoor shower • Indoor/Outdoor Living at it's finest! • 4 bedroom, sleeps 10 comfortably • 2 spacious living areas with large, flat screen TVs • Large kitchen with cypress ceilings + additional kitchenette • Multiple outdoor space to enjoy including wrap around deck • Walk to town of Seaside and Beach within 5 minutes • Parking for 5 • Welcome Tote included • Sandpiper Linen Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. ✨OPTIONAL ADD-ONS✨ → Optional Cancellation Protection → Allows cancellation for ANY reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies paid returned ($150 fee applies at booking). → Pool heat available for $350/per booking in the winter → Pet fee of $250 Angel’s Share – A Private Oasis in the Heart of 30A Just 2 blocks from both the beach and Seaside, Angel’s Share offers the perfect blend of location, luxury, and privacy. Nestled under magnolia and oak trees on charming Forest Street, this 4-bedroom, 2-bath home features a private heated pool, two spacious living areas, and multiple outdoor spaces designed for relaxing and entertaining. Upstairs, enjoy an open-concept living/dining area with vaulted cypress ceilings, a wrap-around deck with grill, and a fully equipped kitchen with stainless steel appliances. The main floor also includes a Queen bedroom and full bath. Downstairs features a second living room, kitchenette, 3 additional bedrooms; including a fun bunk room and direct access to the screened-in porch and pool. Walk or bike to the beach, Seaside’s shops and restaurants, or enjoy peaceful evenings at home under the stars. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: Level 2 (main floor of the property) Large, open concept family room with 55" TV and large sectional sofa Kitchen with granite tops and butcher block island Dining area seats 10 inside with additional dining on screened porch Grill on the wrap around deck • Bedroom 1: QUEEN bedroom Full Bathroom with shower only ✦Level 1 Casual second living room with 50" TV with direct access to the pool • Bedroom 2: KING Bedroom (as of Jan 2026) overlooking pool • Bedroom 3: QUEEN bunk room with built in seating and storage • Bedroom 4: Bunk room (TWINS) sleeping 4- perfect for kids or groups with 2 sets of twin bunks Kitchenette- Equipped with refrigerator, microwave, sink, coffee maker and w/d Full bath with tub/shower combo ✨IMPORTANT DETAILS ✨ The downstairs porch opens to the 24’ x 10’ pool (optional heating fee of $350 per booking) in the private fenced back yard. The backyard features a grilling/barbecue area and outdoor seating with chaise lounges and table seating on the brick paved pool deck. Non-shedding dog allowed with a $250 pet fee Location pictures are of the towns of Seaside (walking distance), Rosemary Beach and Seacrest town centers (biking or driving distance). 2 BIKES INCLUDED! Golf carts are allowed in this community. Ask us for an exclusive daily rate discount for being a Sandpiper guest. FREE WIFI

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
